title: Called-Due Appraisal Carry on Short-Sale Payoffs
content:
Valuation charges — Short-sale called-due appraisal carry, Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

*Input.* The property type recorded on the loan under the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) product, on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record.

*Judgement and result.*
- A two-to-four-unit property: the short-sale called-due appraisal carry is USD 650.00.
- An FHA-approved condominium or a manufactured home: the short-sale called-due appraisal carry is USD 550.00.
- Every other property, and a Summit loan, which records no property type: no adjustment under this rule.

*Where it is used.* The short-sale called-due appraisal carry enters the short-sale accrual basis.

The rule turns on the recorded property type alone; the plan the HECM is held under and the date of the appraisal play no part in it.
